# Fixture provenance

- `synthetic_companyfacts.json` / `synthetic_submissions.json`: invented small figures and a fictional issuer (CIK 0000000001). Generated by `scripts/make_synthetic_fixture.py`. No claim of real SEC records; the example parser never creates source links for these synthetic records. Network-mock tests repurpose their shape solely to exercise the real transport path.
- `reconciled_companies.json`: 48 numerical observations for Apple FY2023–2025, Microsoft FY2024–2026 and KSPI FY2023–2025, retrieved 17 October 2026. Compared with separate official filing XBRL instances using consolidated annual USD/KZT contexts. Includes actual filing URLs and hashes. This is a frozen historical test sample, not a live dataset or universal source audit. Full company filings/API responses are not bundled.

The synthetic data test edge cases; the dated real-company sample tests known financial outputs and provenance. Neither may be silently substituted when a live request fails.

- `kspi_companyfacts.json` / `kspi_submissions.json`: reduced official IFRS/KZT/20-F observations retrieved 17 October 2026 for selection regression tests. Preserve the source metadata; these are historical fixtures, not current API responses.
